title: The Quiet Door
blurb: Strangers at your breakfast table want you to open a mountain door that was locked from the inside.
you: You are a gardener. You live in a warm house dug into a green hill, you like three meals a day, and you have never been further than the market road. You would like to keep it that way.
setup: This morning four strangers walked into your kitchen and ate your breakfast. They want you to come with them. Their families lived in a great hall inside a mountain. Eighty years ago they all ran out of it in one night, and nobody has been back since. Now they are going home. They need someone small and quiet who is good with their hands, and Alvard says that is you. There is one thing they do not like talking about: the big doors were locked from the inside. So somebody stayed in there.
goal: Walk to the mountain with them, get the door open, and find out what is inside.
opening: Your kitchen, far too full of strangers, with a paper on the table you have not signed.
tone: A cosy adventure that gets bigger than anyone expected. Warm jokes about food and comfort. Surprising, never frightening. Whatever is in the mountain, the story stays kind.

narrator.style: Clear, warm American audiobook narrator. Well-projected and easy to follow at speed, with crisp consonants and real energy. Never soft, sleepy or lilting.
narrator.bio: Tells the tale of the road and the country it crosses. Speaks to the listener as 'you'. Describes the world and what happens in it, never what you decide.

alvard.style: Very deep and very slow. Dry and amused. Leaves a pause before the important word.
alvard.bio: An old travelling tinker who mends pots and knows far too much. He picked you, and he will not say why. He is old enough that eighty years ago sounds like last week to him.
alvard.condition: Calm. Far too relaxed about all of this.

hesta.style: Bright and direct. Proud. Speaks clearly and never rushes her words.
hesta.bio: She leads the group, and the mountain hall should have been hers. She was born after they fled and grew up on stories about it. She is good at this, and secretly afraid that home will turn out to be a disappointment.
hesta.condition: Ready to leave. Boots already on.

yarrow.style: Cheerful and lively, but clear and easy to follow. Never gabbles.
yarrow.bio: The group's scout. Friendly, terrible at keeping secrets, and the only one who will say out loud what everyone is thinking. Genuinely brilliant on a cliff.

extras.style: Bright and young, but clear and unhurried.
Light and lyrical, with clear words.

props.the paper: Not signed yet. On your kitchen table, in very small writing.
